Name: Red Heeler Dog Retexture
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]This mod retextures one of the pet dogs so that it looks like a red heeler, or red Australian cattle dog.

You can set which dog it replaces (dog, dog1, or dog2) and you can select a choice of seven different coloured collars (or no collar!) and whether or not the collar has a tag.

[b]Update[/b]: 1.1.0 now makes it possible to have the red heeler as an additional breed! No need to replace the vanilla dogs, it'll now be available as a separate option in the new game character creation menu or will be available to adopt from Marnie's. Set "Add as New Breed" to "true", or if you'd prefer to continue replacing a vanilla dog, set it to "false".

[b]Installation[/b]:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download the mod, extract the “[CP] Red Heeler Dog Retexture” folder, and drop it in your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]By default, the dog will replace the first dog option and will not have a collar. If you want a different option, run the game once with [/size]
[size=3]the mod installed to generate a config.json file in the mod folder.
[/size][*][size=3]Open the config.json and edit the options you’d like.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3][b]Options[/b]:[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Add as New Breed[/b]: true, false[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Which Dog[/b]: dog, dog1, dog2[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Collar Colour[/b]: none, black, white, red, yellow, green, blue, purple[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Collar Tag[/b]: true, false[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Whitebalverines’ blue heeler / blue Australian cattle dog in their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1491]Australian Dog Pack[/url] mod was used as a base outline. Thanks very much for the permission!
[/size]
